item.tib: 'chi med yab sras kyi tshe sgrub tshe srog 'gug pa'i lcags kyu lus khams pad mo rgyas pa'i nyi ma
item.coloph: zhes pa'i tshe sgrub gsum gzhung gcig tu dril ba 'di 'dra bsgrigs dgos pa do gal chen pos rnal 'byor nges don snying pos yang yang bskul ba brten te khri ba mkhyen rab rgya mtshor 'bod pas bsgrigs pa la nyes 'gal gang mchis bshags shing dge bas 'gro kun 'chi med tshe lha'i go 'phang thob pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
